name: Khoj
description: Self-hostable personal AI that answers from your documents and the internet using local or hosted models.
whatItDoes: Works as a second brain: it chats over your notes and files (PDF, markdown, org-mode, Word, Notion, images) and the web. It is reachable from a browser, Obsidian, Emacs, a desktop app, phone or WhatsApp.
howItWorks: A Python server indexes personal documents for semantic retrieval and combines that with online search when answering. It works with any local or online chat model. Self-hosting steps are in the project documentation rather than the README.

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: A local model or a key for a hosted model

models: Local models (llama3, qwen, gemma, mistral) and hosted GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek
